meta.method: GA4 weekly users are deduplicated: one report call per Mon-Sun week with no date dimension, never summed from daily rows. Campaign spend and campaign booking conversions were pulled as two separate GAQL queries because segments.conversion_action_name cannot be selected alongside cost_micros.
